_comment: Named test scenarios. `teams` is a mix of behaviour archetypes, which stand in for how guests might actually play. They are a testing instrument, not a prediction.

scenarios.name: CURRENT — 10 teams, mixed play
scenarios.description: The current design: three items each, one decision a round (where do we go), and a trivia matchup wherever two teams land together.

scenarios.name: CURRENT — everybody plays it safe
scenarios.description: Worst case: every team avoids the busy places. Does the game still produce a showdown?

scenarios.name: CURRENT — everybody chases the treasure
scenarios.description: Worst case: every team goes for the richest spot. Does the field wipe itself out?

scenarios.name: CURRENT — 6 teams
scenarios.description: A smaller gathering on the same board.

scenarios.name: Full party — mixed behaviour
scenarios.description: Ten teams, a realistic spread of greedy, cautious, contrarian and adaptive play.

scenarios.name: Worst case — everybody hides
scenarios.description: The stall scenario. If every team plays it safe, does the night still produce a finale?

scenarios.name: Worst case — everybody hunts the loot
scenarios.description: The bloodbath scenario. If everyone chases the same visible power-ups, does the field collapse too early?

scenarios.name: Small party — 6 teams
scenarios.description: A smaller gathering on the same wedge. Does the funnel still land on 2-3?

scenarios.name: Drunk table — everybody guesses
scenarios.description: Nobody is playing strategically at all. The true floor.

scenarios.name: Full party — deep cover is not a sanctuary
scenarios.description: The same ten teams, but hiding in deep cover no longer makes a team untouchable: a hunter who comes to the same place still finds them.

scenarios.name: Everybody hides — without the sanctuary
scenarios.description: The stall scenario again, with deep cover downgraded to ordinary quiet ground.

scenarios.name: Tight wedge — mixed behaviour
scenarios.description: Ten teams on the 5/3/2 wedge. Does a narrower board fix the dead rounds?

scenarios.name: Tight wedge — everybody hides
scenarios.description: The stall scenario on the narrower board, with no sanctuary.

scenarios.name: No postures — wide wedge (8/5/3)
scenarios.description: Posture removed: every meeting is a fight. Ten teams on the wider board.

scenarios.name: No postures — tight wedge (5/3/2)
scenarios.description: Posture removed, on the tighter board. Expected to collapse.

scenarios.name: No postures — everybody plays it safe
scenarios.description: The old stall scenario with posture removed. Can a timid field still produce nothing?
